name: play
description: Play — one repository for the creator studio, the learner marketplace, a third-party demo app, and the AWS backend they share.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace play-studio && npm run build --workspace play-marketplace && npm run build --workspace play-demo
scripts.get-env: npm run get-env --workspace play-studio && npm run get-env --workspace play-marketplace && npm run get-env --workspace play-demo
